decisions.reason: The flame-retardant curtain fabric serves the contract and hospitality projects the firm targets, and its continued standalone presentation suggests results at or above aspiration, so problemistic search is not triggered.

The wool-blend fabric is only mentioned rather than featured and sits uneasily with the goal of reducing hard-to-recycle blends, but it fits the push toward renewable materials and is cheap to carry as one item in a broad range, so it stays for now while its results remain uncertain.

Launched in 2024 and presented on its own page, the braided fabric is too new to judge against aspiration, and the firm's pattern of dropping weaker products within a year signals it currently meets expectations, so it gets time to prove itself.
